Some of AnkiMobile's features include:

Please note that AnkiMobile is currently intended as a companion to the computer version of Anki, rather than a complete replacement for it. Add-ons are not supported, so while you can study image occlusion cards created with the computer version, they can not be created within AnkiMobile. Fight the aliens taking over the world and achieve an excellent knowledge of the multiplication table!

How it works:
The game consists of 17 levels of difficulty, starting with multiplication tasks on single digits, then they get harder and multiplier combinations become arbitrary.
Levels can be completed repeatedly, this allows you to earn weapons for completing more difficult tasks.
So if you come across a difficult task that you can't pass in any way, go back to the previous level and get that help.
This way you will repeat and consolidate the previously passed material, and at the same time you will always be able to move forward.

Once you have gone through the entire game, create a new player profile (there is no limit to the number of profiles) and go through it again.
See if you can do it faster and get an even higher total score.
Also, create additional profiles for your kids, your family and friends and compete against each other.

Game features and techniques:
1. This game uses a special way of learning multiplication - through factorization (multiplication by multipliers).
This requires a deeper and more confident knowledge of the multiplication table, not only forward but also backward.
2. Game mechanics. The alien spaceship must be hit by the robots you control. To do this, guide the rays from the robots to the alien spaceships. If the multiplication result matches, the spaceship will be destroyed.
3. Complication. Each level becomes more difficult than the previous one: multipliers increase, the number of ships increases and they shoot faster.
4. Additional complication. If the game seems too easy, turn on random multiplier order in the settings and try to pass it in this mode.
5. Weapons. Playing the previous levels and breaking your previous records gives you additional weapons for battles. It allows you to stop time for 10 or 20 seconds. During this pause, the alien ships will freeze and will not fire at your robots.
6. Hints. There is also a hint that does not spend points - to do this, click on the light bulb during the game, the entire multiplication table up to 10 will be displayed on the screen. But it spends more time, which you need to save when passing the level.
7. Training. In the menu, you have the option to select an arbitrary desired multiplication range and train in it.
8. Achievement Diary. The app keeps a record of all your games and their results. You can see how you have progressed from the beginning.
